test_blockpartition_solve: test the blockpartition.solve function to split a list of numbers into balanced partitions
test_balance_by_time: test the balance_by_time function to partition a PyTorch model by layer execution time
test_balance_by_size: test the balance_by_size function to partition a PyTorch model by parameter and activation size
test_layerwise_sandbox: test the layerwise_sandbox function to profile individual model layers in isolation on a target device
test_balance_by_size_param_scale: test the balance_by_size function with param_scale to weight parameter size versus activation size
